entries.title: Firstmate asks which way to add a Mac
entries.body: Ask Firstmate to add another Mac without saying how, and it asks you on one card. The card offers every way: a link, a command, the Mac's address, or another user on this Mac. Before, it picked one way for you, so its card could leave out the way you wanted.
entries.noPicture: Firstmate writes this card in its own words each time it asks, so no one picture shows it.
